name: get_observe_view
description:

Missing/stale feedback/calibration is an explicit failure. Call move_to only when success,moved_target,endpoint_safe are all true; move_to must still plan the complete path. Calculation may capture/cache observations but never commands motion. Inclusive timeout 30 seconds.
